import pathlib,subprocess,json,hashlib,re,tempfile,shutil
R=pathlib.Path('/home/mii/code/konOSuba/biomiya');C=R/'core-s';D=R/'docs/workflows/bootstrap-b31';sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest();c=json.loads((D/'N3-r1-candidate.json').read_text());assert sha(D/'N3-r1-candidate.json')=='ed77d0dec957acc843c1554df339f729a7e2fec5736c4d4c6e4c12c6fbdf2a8d'
for p,h in dict(c['files'],**c['input_hashes']).items():assert sha(R/p)==h,p
base=json.loads((D/'baseline.json').read_text())['files']
for phase in ['N1','N2']:base.update({p:h for p,h in json.loads((D/f'{phase}-r1-candidate.json').read_text())['files'].items() if p.startswith('core-s/')})
for p,h in base.items():
 if p not in c['files']:assert sha(R/p)==h,p
for evidence in ['N3-integration-evidence.json','N3-machine-final-probe-evidence.json']:
 e=json.loads((D/evidence).read_text())
 for p,h in e['input_hashes'].items():assert sha(C/p)==h,(evidence,p)
rules=(C/'bootstrap/rules.vt').read_text();refs=set(re.findall(r'model::([A-Za-z_0-9]+)',rules));constant_names=set(re.findall(r'pub const (\w+):',(C/'bootstrap/model.vt').read_text()));assert refs<=constant_names;assert not re.search(r'\b(unsafe|static)\b',re.sub(r'//[^\n]*','',rules));assert re.findall(r'^import (.*);',rules,re.M)==['bootstrap::model']
tmp=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='b31-n3-independent-'));(tmp/'build').mkdir();manifest=(C/'bootstrap/c1.build').read_text();paths=[x.split()[1] for x in manifest.splitlines() if x.startswith(('source ','assembly '))]
for f in paths:
 q=tmp/f;q.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);q.write_bytes((C/f).read_bytes())
(tmp/'compiler.build').write_text(manifest.replace('output build/c1.elf','output build/compiler.elf'))
result={'candidate_sha256':sha(D/'N3-r1-candidate.json'),'directory':str(tmp),'rules_model_references':sorted(refs),'cases':[],'commands':[]}
def run(args,cwd=tmp):
 p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env={'PATH':''},capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90);return {'argv':args,'exit':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}
p=run([str(C/'target/debug/core-s'),'project','compiler.build']);assert p['exit']==0,p;result['commands'].append(p);compiler=tmp/'build/compiler.elf';compiler.chmod(0o755);result['compiler_sha256']=sha(compiler)
assert result['compiler_sha256']==json.loads((D/'N3-integration-evidence.json').read_text())['binaries']['c1']
cases=[]
for ty,w in [('u8',8),('u32',32),('usize',64)]:
 maxn=(1<<w)-1;v=lambda n:f'{n}_{ty}'
 rows=[(v(maxn)+'+%'+v(1),0),(v(0)+'-%'+v(1),maxn),(v(maxn)+'*%'+v(maxn),(maxn*maxn)&maxn),(v(1)+'<<'+v(w-1),1<<(w-1)),(v(maxn)+'>>'+v(w-1),1),(v(maxn)+'/ '+v(2),maxn//2),(v(maxn)+'%'+v(2),maxn%2),('~'+v(0),maxn),('-'+v(0),0),(v(maxn)+'+ '+v(1),None),(v(0)+'- '+v(1),None),(v(maxn)+'* '+v(2),None),(v(1)+'<<'+v(w),None),(v(1)+'>>'+v(w),None),(v(1)+'/ '+v(0),None),(v(1)+'%'+v(0),None),('-'+v(1),None)]
 cases += [(ty,e,want) for e,want in rows]
cases += [('u8','4294967295_u32 as u8',255),('u32','18446744073709551615_usize as u32',4294967295),('usize','255_u8 as usize',255),('bool','!false',True),('bool','true&&false',False),('bool','false||true',True),('u8','true as u8',None),('bool','1_u8 as bool',None)]
for num,(ty,expr,want) in enumerate(cases):
 for walker in ['both'] if want is not None else ['const','static']:
  if want is not None:
   expected=('true' if want else 'false') if ty=='bool' else f'{want}_{ty}'
   source=f'const C:{ty}={expr}; static S:{ty}={expr}; pub fn run()->u32{{if C=={expected} && S=={expected}{{return 0;}}return 9;}}'
  else:source=f'{walker} X:{ty}={expr};pub fn run()->u32{{return 0;}}'
  case=tmp/f'case-{num}-{walker}';case.mkdir();(case/'main.vt').write_text(source);(case/'main.build').write_text('format 1\nprofile linux-user\nentry run\nsource main.vt\noutput out.elf\n')
  p=run(['/usr/bin/qemu-riscv64','-s','1048576',str(compiler),'build','main.build'],case);row={'type':ty,'expression':expr,'expected':want,'walker':walker,'compile':p}
  if want is None:assert p['exit']==1 and 'E_TYPE' in p['stderr'] and not(case/'out.elf').exists(),row
  else:
   assert p['exit']==0,row;(case/'out.elf').chmod(0o755);row['execute']=run(['/usr/bin/qemu-riscv64','-s','1048576','out.elf'],case);assert row['execute']['exit']==0,row
  result['cases'].append(row)
# Full static validation must not skip tails, empty repetitions, or nested payloads.
invalid=[
'static S:[2]u32=[1_u32,true];',
'struct P{a:u32,b:u32}static S:P=P{a:1,b:true};',
'struct P{a:u32,b:[2]u32}static S:P=P{a:1,b:[0_u32,true]};',
'static S:[0]u32=[true;0];',
'static S:[0]u32=[1_u32/0_u32;0];',
'static S:[2][0]u32=[[0_u32;0],[true;0]];',
'static S:Result<u32,u32>=Result::<u32,u32>::Err(true);',
'static S:[2]Result<u32,u32>=[Result::<u32,u32>::Ok(1),Result::<u32,u32>::Err(true)];',
'struct P{a:u32,b:u32}static S:P=P{a:1,b:0,a:2};']
result['static_rejections']=[]
for i,s in enumerate(invalid):
 case=tmp/f'aggregate-{i}';case.mkdir();(case/'main.vt').write_text(s+'pub fn run()->u32{return 0;}');(case/'main.build').write_text('format 1\nprofile linux-user\nentry run\nsource main.vt\noutput out.elf\n');p=run(['/usr/bin/qemu-riscv64','-s','1048576',str(compiler),'build','main.build'],case);assert p['exit']==1 and not(case/'out.elf').exists(),(s,p);assert 'E_TYPE' in p['stderr'] or 'E_NAME' in p['stderr'],(s,p);result['static_rejections'].append({'source':s,'result':p})
# Pure rules run before initialization and again after deliberate global-table pollution.
checks=[('rules::literal(256,model::TYPE_U8)',False,0),('rules::binary(model::BIN_EQ,0,0,model::TYPE_UNIT)',True,1),('rules::binary(model::BIN_EQ,1,0,model::TYPE_UNIT)',False,0),('rules::binary(model::BIN_OR,2,0,model::TYPE_BOOL)',False,0),('rules::binary(22,0,0,model::TYPE_U8)',False,0),('rules::binary(model::BIN_ADD,1,1,0)',False,0),('rules::binary(model::BIN_WRAP_MUL,4294967295,4294967295,model::TYPE_U32)',True,1),('rules::cast(18446744073709551615,model::TYPE_USIZE,model::TYPE_U8)',True,255),('rules::unary(model::UNARY_NOT,2,model::TYPE_BOOL)',False,0)]
body=''.join(f'let r{i}:rules::ScalarRule={expr};if r{i}.ok!={str(ok).lower()} || r{i}.bits!={bits}_usize{{return {i+1};}}' for i,(expr,ok,bits) in enumerate(checks))
body+='if rules::add_size(18446744073709551615,1).ok||rules::align_up(1,3).ok||rules::align_up(18446744073709551615,8).ok{return 20;}if rules::align_up(67108865,4096).size!=67112960_usize||rules::align_up(18446744073709551615,1).size!=18446744073709551615_usize{return 21;}return 0;'
source='module pure;import bootstrap::model;import bootstrap::rules;fn test()->u32{'+body+'}pub fn run()->u32{let before:u32=test();if before!=0_u32{return before;}unsafe{model::type_count=0;model::types[3].kind=model::TYPE_STRUCT;model::types[3].size=123;model::slots[1].ty=999;model::decl_count=777;}return test();}'
(tmp/'pure.vt').write_text(source);(tmp/'pure.build').write_text('format 1\nprofile linux-user\nentry pure::run\nsource bootstrap/model.vt\nsource bootstrap/rules.vt\nsource pure.vt\nassembly runtime/linux.s0\noutput build/pure.elf\n');p=run([str(C/'target/debug/core-s'),'project','pure.build']);assert p['exit']==0,p;(tmp/'build/pure.elf').chmod(0o755);q=run(['/usr/bin/qemu-riscv64','-s','1048576','build/pure.elf']);assert q['exit']==0,q;result['pure_probe']={'source':source,'build':p,'execute':q}
pathlib.Path('/tmp/b31-n3-independent-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print(json.dumps({'compiler_hash':result['compiler_sha256'],'scalar_walker_cases':len(result['cases']),'static_rejections':len(invalid),'pure_probe_exit':q['exit'],'directory':str(tmp)},indent=2))
